novel_features.name: Date-fit scan
novel_features.description: See observed session and option-price differences across up to seven itinerary dates.
novel_features.rationale: It correlates source calendar statuses with exact option amounts and observation times.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when a traveler can move an activity between nearby dates.

novel_features.name: Constraint-aware shortlist
novel_features.description: Compare a few known plans against explicit age, party, time, price, and language constraints.
novel_features.rationale: It retains unknowns and item errors instead of treating missing facts as a match.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use after collecting Activity Japan plan IDs or links.

novel_features.name: Price-basis report
novel_features.description: See source option IDs, selected-date amounts, participant basis, and excluded extras.
novel_features.rationale: It joins headline, dated option and fee evidence without inventing checkout totals.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before comparing activity costs for a specific party.

novel_features.name: Language-surface check
novel_features.description: Check whether a plan ID is indexed in English, Japanese, or both.
novel_features.rationale: It compares separate official sitemap inventories and returns locale-specific canonical links.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before handing an English-language source link to a traveler.

novel_features.name: Handoff readiness
novel_features.description: Get a compact booking-handoff packet with known conditions and unresolved questions.
novel_features.rationale: It unifies live session, eligibility, location, cancellation, price and freshness evidence.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when the traveler is ready to review the official booking page.

narrative.headline: Source-backed Japan experiences with explicit plan, price, language and availability evidence.
narrative.value_prop: Inspect Activity Japan plans and future dates in compact JSON. Compare a bounded shortlist against traveler constraints and carry source uncertainty through booking handoff.
narrative.auth_narrative: Known-plan JSON endpoints and plan sitemaps are anonymous. Independent CLI search listings are WAF challenged. Booking remains on Activity Japan.

quickstart.comment: Inspect a known plan, Japanese name and source conditions.
Observe future sessions without making a reservation.
Read one dated option quote and age-aware subtotal.

troubleshoots.symptom: Activity Japan search is blocked or challenged
troubleshoots.fix: Use a known plan ID or provide approved site clearance; the CLI reports search coverage explicitly.

troubleshoots.symptom: A plan ID returns HTML instead of JSON
troubleshoots.fix: Treat it as a source/schema error and verify the ID on the canonical Activity Japan plan page.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for known Activity Japan plan IDs or URLs: source detail, dated price and session checks, a bounded comparison, and canonical booking handoff.
anti_triggers: Do not use for confirmed reservations or payment.
Do not use website language as proof of instructor language.
Do not use for experiences sold only by other providers.
